scorecard.rationale: The Parkinson baseline graphic shows a very small inverse association for unspecified coconut oil and reported dyskinesia. The MCT Parkinson comparisons give no consistent item-specific change, and a GLUT1 deficiency case involved a distinct movement disorder. The virgin oil effect remains unresolved. The coconut oil paragraph refers to the earlier cross-sectional PRO-PD cohort already cited. It has no separate dyskinesia estimate or confirmation of virgin-grade oil.
